internal.title: Incident Report: High Latency in Ad Service Resolved
internal.body:
At 12:21 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for high latency in the ad service. The p95 latency reached 1.8 seconds, significantly above normal levels, while error rates remained low, indicating a latency-specific issue. Supporting evidence showed elevated latency in related services: checkout and frontend, contributing to the overall problem.

Diagnosis identified high CPU usage flagged in the ad service as the root cause. A mitigation action was proposed and approved to disable the high CPU usage flag (adHighCpu). This action was executed at 12:41 UTC, resulting in a rapid recovery with latency dropping back to normal levels (p95 latency reduced to 0.12 seconds).

The incident was resolved promptly after the mitigation, with no further latency issues detected. Continuous monitoring remains in place to prevent recurrence.
